other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal categorical handling in XGBoost
other_failure_modes.description: Ordinal encoded categorical features are passed to XGBoost as floats without enabling categorical support, causing the model to treat them as continuous variables which is mathematically suboptimal for tree splits.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold CV ensemble with optimized blending weights and basic data cleaning for string-formatted numericals. However, it leaks test set categories by fitting the OrdinalEncoder on the combined train and test sets, and fails to engineer any meaningful new features. Additionally, it evaluates the models solely on RMSE without verifying metric robustness.
